02 / UNDERSTANDING RESULTS

What do the categories mean?

Each category describes the documentation available for the product.

A

Green

Complete excipient list; no relevant ingredient identified within the limits of the documentation.

Keep a copy of the leaflet.
C

Amber

Source not stated, information incomplete or wording ambiguous.

Check official information or contact the manufacturer. Do not stop the medicine.
B

Red

Wheat- or gluten-related ingredient or warning documented.

Discuss options with the prescriber.
D

Blue

A gluten-free claim is documented but has not been verified.

Ask for supporting information and check the full list.

07 / ABOUT THE PROJECT

Research scope and methodology

The Gluten-Related Excipient Information Tool is a pharmacist quick-reference and counseling guide developed at the University of Tripoli, Faculty of Pharmacy, Department of Pharmaceutics.

Version 1.0 contains 111 oral medicines, supplements and herbal products collected from community pharmacies in Tripoli, Libya during August–September 2026.

The database reports documented excipient wording and a documentary category. It does not measure gluten and has not been pilot-tested with users in the source guide.

Source and update policy

Source: Gluten-Related Excipient Information Tool, Pharmacist Quick-Reference and Counseling Guide, Version 1.0. Product formulations may change. The source guide recommends rechecking entries every 6–12 months and whenever a new presentation is dispensed. Updates should be verified and versioned by the research administrator.
